pay_step_increment_003.evidence:
Advancement from Level 1 to Level 2 is based on the following:
        a. Years of experience
        b. Successful yearly evaluations
        c. PED licensure level
         Advancement requires a minimum of three (3) years of experience at each level.

pay_prior_experience_005.evidence:
Credit within each salary matrix shall be given for all years of qualified experience in a licensed educational role
         One year of qualified experience is designated as at least five hundred seventy (570) hours of verifiable experience.
